messages:
alex: quick heads-up — hotfix #721 (kv-cache ordering) needs double approval before 23:45 PT cutoff or we roll to the fallback RC. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/7212 — pinging reviewers because this touches serving path

olivia: @sanjay @maya can one of you spare 5–10m to review? if not i can take it but i might need a second eye for the perf change

sanjay: i'll take a look now. looks small from the diff, mostly reordering eviction. running quick smoke locally: `./scripts/smoke.sh --short`

deploy-bot: build #9842 completed · CI: ✅ linux · flaky-windows: failing 2 tests (known flakes)

maya: skimmed diff, left two tiny inline comments (naming + one log). tests pass on my VM. willing to approve after the nits are addressed

alex: pushed a small follow-up to fix the naming and removed the noisy log. CI retriggered

sanjay: re-running local perf check, looks within baseline (+0.6% tail). i can give an approve once the CI is green

olivia: quick sanity pass from me in prod-sim — behavior looks stable. adding my approval now. LGTM

sanjay: LGTM — merging once the final CI job passes. please tag canary and watch error budget

alex: merging in 30s and kicking canary with `--rollout=canary --max-failure=0.05` — i'll monitor logs and latency, will post updates here

release-czar: holding cutoff at 23:45 PT. if canary error rate >5% or latency tail spikes >100ms above baseline within first 10m, roll back and notify infra-oncall. good job team :thumbsup:

alex: canary deployed, first 5m look clean. will report at +10m and +30m. thanks for the quick turnaround everyone :tada:
